channel.title: The Argo: the house of chiptopher.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Menphon #9423 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae)
item.description: Menphon #9423 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Archmedes #9787 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Argyreoi made room
item.description: Archmedes #9787 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Argyreoi made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.title: Broken, not dead: Glaukias #9537 (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)). The Reaper
item.description: Broken, not dead: Glaukias #9537 (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.description: Ikardotos #5324 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.
